Info

Defines structural runtime-checkable protocol IArcInterpolator for circular arc segmentation.

class scarajectory.core.service.dsl.compiler.iarc_interpolator.IArcInterpolator(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: Protocol

Structural protocol defining contract for circular arc Cartesian segmentation.

It defines:

attributes:
None.
methods:
interpolate - Generates discrete points and tangent angles along circular arc.
_abc_impl = <_abc._abc_data object>¶
_is_protocol = True¶
_is_runtime_protocol = True¶
interpolate(*, start_x: float, start_y: float, target_x: float, target_y: float, offset_i: float, offset_j: float, is_clockwise: bool, step_angle_deg: float = 5.0) → tuple[tuple[float, float, float], ...][source]¶

Segments circular arc into intermediate coordinates and tangent angles.

Parameters:

  • start_x – Starting arc X coordinate.

  • start_y – Starting arc Y coordinate.

  • target_x – Destination arc X coordinate.

  • target_y – Destination arc Y coordinate.

  • offset_i – Center X offset from start.

  • offset_j – Center Y offset from start.

  • is_clockwise – True for ARC_CW, False for ARC_CCW.

  • step_angle_deg – Angular discretization step size in degrees.

Returns:

Tuple of (px, py, tangent_deg) tuples.
